title: useEffect – React
description: Reference for useEffect, dependencies, cleanup, and common pitfalls.
content_text: useEffect runs after render. Provide a dependency array to control when it re-runs; return a cleanup function to unsubscribe or cancel.

title: asyncio — Tasks and Coroutines
description: Handy reminders: create_task, gather, shield, and cancellation behavior.
content_text: asyncio tasks wrap coroutines. gather aggregates results; cancellation propagates unless return_exceptions is used. create_task schedules immediately on the loop.

title: Secrets | Kubernetes
description: K8s Secret types, encoding vs encryption, and best practices.
content_text: Secrets store sensitive data like tokens and passwords. Use RBAC, encryption at rest, and avoid committing manifests with literals; prefer external secret managers.

title: Using Amazon EventBridge for SaaS event routing
description: Patterns for multi-tenant event routing and partner event sources.
content_text: EventBridge supports partner event sources and rules for filtering. Multi-tenant routing can use event bus per tenant or shared bus with tenant identifiers and DLQs.

title: CREATE INDEX — PostgreSQL
description: Index types, concurrent builds, and pitfalls with expressions.
content_text: CREATE INDEX builds a new index. CONCURRENTLY avoids blocking writes but takes longer and cannot run inside a transaction block. Expression indexes can speed derived predicates.

title: Webhooks | Stripe Documentation
description: Endpoint signing, retries, and idempotency tips.
content_text: Stripe signs webhook events. Verify signatures using the signing secret. Use idempotency in your processing and handle retries; respond quickly and process asynchronously.

title: 429 Too Many Requests - HTTP | MDN
description: Quick reference when debugging rate limiting responses.
content_text: HTTP 429 indicates the user has sent too many requests in a given amount of time. Use Retry-After, exponential backoff, and client-side throttling.

title: Notion API best practices
description: Notes on pagination, caching, and avoiding rate limits.
content_text: Prefer incremental sync via cursor pagination. Cache database schemas, batch requests, and handle 429 with retry/backoff. Store Notion IDs as strings.

title: benbjohnson/litestream
description: Streaming SQLite replication to S3/GCS; good fit for small services.
content_text: Litestream continuously replicates SQLite to object storage for backup and restore. Supports S3, GCS, Azure Blob. Useful for single-node apps needing durability.

title: About Google Analytics 4 data retention
description: Default retention and how it impacts explorations and reports.
content_text: GA4 retains user-level data for a configurable period. Standard reports aren’t affected the same way as explorations. Adjust retention in Admin settings as needed.

title: Design Systems 101
description: Good primer for tokens, components, and governance in product teams.
content_text: Design systems combine reusable components with guidelines. Strong governance and tooling help teams scale UI changes and maintain accessibility and consistency.

title: RFC 9110: HTTP Semantics
description: Canonical reference for HTTP semantics, methods, and status codes.
content_text: HTTP semantics define methods, status codes, headers, caching, and conditional requests. Useful when implementing proxies, caches, and API gateways.

title: golang-migrate/migrate
description: DB schema migrations for Go; supports Postgres/MySQL/SQLite.
content_text: migrate provides CLI and library for applying versioned migrations. Supports multiple databases and source URLs. Good for CI/CD and local dev workflows.

title: Introducing structured outputs in the API
description: Notes on getting JSON outputs with schemas and reduced parsing pain.
content_text: Structured outputs aim to improve reliability for JSON responses. Use a defined schema, validate on receipt, and fall back to retries for transient failures.

title: Application Performance Monitoring | Sentry
description: APM overview; useful for explaining traces vs spans internally.
content_text: Sentry Performance adds distributed tracing, transaction metrics, and profiling to help find slow endpoints and N+1 queries. Works with multiple SDKs.

title: Train and evaluate with Keras
description: Reference for model.fit/evaluate/predict and common callbacks.
content_text: Keras training uses model.compile then model.fit. Use callbacks for early stopping, checkpoints, and TensorBoard. Works with tf.data for scalable input pipelines.

title: Attention Is All You Need
description: Transformer paper; keep for citations and architecture refreshers.
content_text: Introduces the Transformer architecture based on self-attention, enabling parallel training and strong sequence modeling results without recurrence or convolution.

title: torch.nn.CrossEntropyLoss — PyTorch
description: Label smoothing and ignore_index notes.
content_text: CrossEntropyLoss combines LogSoftmax and NLLLoss. Supports class weights, ignore_index, and label_smoothing. Input is logits of shape (N, C, ...).

title: NVIDIA DGX H100
description: Specs page; pricing varies but good for capacity planning slides.
content_text: DGX H100 is an AI supercomputer system with H100 GPUs, high-bandwidth NVLink/NVSwitch, and enterprise software stack for training and inference workloads.

title: Caching dependencies to speed up workflows - GitHub Actions
description: Snippet for adding cache keys; avoids repeated installs in CI.
content_text: Use actions/cache to persist dependencies between workflow runs. Create deterministic keys from lockfiles and restore keys for partial matches to reduce CI time.

title: Using source control in Xcode | Apple Developer Documentation
description: Notes for onboarding: accounts, remotes, and PR workflows.
content_text: Xcode integrates Git with commit, branch, stash, and push/pull flows. Configure accounts, manage remotes, and use the Source Control navigator for history.

title: What is a JQL query? | Atlassian Support
description: JQL basics for filters, saved searches, and dashboards.
content_text: JQL lets you search issues with fields, operators, functions, and clauses. Combine conditions with AND/OR and save filters for dashboards and subscriptions.

title: What is rate limiting? | Cloudflare
description: Shared internally when debating per-user vs per-IP limits.
content_text: Rate limiting restricts how often an action can be repeated. Common strategies include token bucket and leaky bucket. Add headers and clear retry guidance for clients.

title: RFC 6749: The OAuth 2.0 Authorization Framework
description: Authoritative OAuth 2.0 spec for flows and terminology.
content_text: Defines OAuth 2.0 roles, grant types, access tokens, and refresh tokens. Useful when implementing auth servers, clients, and understanding security considerations.

title: Authentication Cheat Sheet - OWASP
description: Practical do/don’t list: MFA, password storage, session hygiene.
content_text: OWASP guidance on secure authentication: MFA, rate limiting, account lockout, secure password hashing (bcrypt/Argon2), and session management best practices.

title: Merge sort (article) | Khan Academy
description: Simple refresher; good link for junior onboarding.
content_text: Merge sort divides the list, sorts each half, then merges. Runtime is O(n log n) and it’s stable. Uses extra memory proportional to n for merging.

title: Intersection Observer API - Web APIs | MDN
description: For lazy-loading images and infinite scroll without scroll handlers.
content_text: Intersection Observer asynchronously observes changes in the intersection of a target element with an ancestor element or viewport. Great for lazy loading and analytics.

title: Circuit Breaker pattern - Azure Architecture Center
description: Reference for resilience review: thresholds, half-open state.
content_text: Circuit breaker prevents repeated calls to failing services. Track failures and open the circuit after threshold. Use half-open trial calls and timeouts to recover safely.

title: Grafana Loki documentation
description: Logging stack notes; includes label best practices and queries.
content_text: Loki stores logs indexed by labels rather than full-text. Keep label cardinality low, use LogQL for querying, and pair with Grafana for dashboards and alerts.

title: Redis Streams
description: Stream consumer groups and ID semantics; useful for queue design.
content_text: Redis Streams support append-only log entries with IDs and consumer groups. Use XREADGROUP for group consumption and XACK to acknowledge processed messages.

title: Edge Middleware (Vercel)
description: Notes on auth gating at the edge and request rewriting.
content_text: Edge Middleware runs before the request completes, enabling rewrites, redirects, and auth checks close to users. Be mindful of cold starts and runtime limits.

title: Routing: Fundamentals | Next.js
description: App Router routing rules: layouts, loading, and route groups.
content_text: Next.js App Router uses filesystem-based routing with nested layouts, templates, and loading UI. Route groups and parallel routes help organize complex apps.

title: Temporal - JavaScript | MDN
description: Tracking Temporal proposal progress; helps avoid Date pitfalls.
content_text: Temporal is a modern date/time API proposal for JavaScript to replace Date. It provides time zones, calendars, and types like PlainDate and ZonedDateTime.

title: 10 Usability Heuristics for User Interface Design
description: Classic Nielsen heuristics; useful for quick design reviews.
content_text: Nielsen’s heuristics include visibility of system status, match between system and real world, user control, consistency, error prevention, and recognition over recall.

title: Geocoding API requests | Google Maps Platform
description: Query params for forward/reverse geocoding and components filter.
content_text: Geocoding API supports address-to-latlng and reverse geocoding. Use components to bias results and handle quota errors with backoff and caching.
